items.title: AX – Google’s Open Agentic Orchestrator
items.summary: Google has launched AX, an open-source orchestrator designed to enhance the capabilities of AI agents. This development is significant for engineers looking to build more sophisticated AI systems that can interact seamlessly with various applications.

items.title: Kev: Tiny Jev-like family of decision models built on top of Qwen3.5
items.summary: The Kev project introduces a new family of decision models that leverage the Qwen3.5 architecture, offering developers a lightweight solution for decision-making tasks in AI applications. This could streamline the development of AI systems that require efficient decision processes.

items.title: Show HN: Mini-AGI – Dynamic continual learning model trained on 8GB VRAM
items.summary: The Mini-AGI project showcases a dynamic continual learning model capable of operating within a constrained VRAM environment, making it accessible for developers with limited resources. This innovation could democratize access to advanced AI capabilities.

items.title: ZuckOff Is a Free App That Sees Meta Glasses Before They See You
items.summary: ZuckOff is a new application that detects the presence of Meta's smart glasses, allowing users to be aware of potential surveillance. This raises important discussions about privacy and user control in the age of pervasive technology.

items.title: Exfiltrate Your Weights
items.summary: The Exfiltrate Your Weights project provides tools for securely managing and transferring machine learning model weights, addressing a critical need for developers in the open-source community. This initiative enhances the security and efficiency of model deployment.
